children.name: LocalScript
children.script_source:
local frame = script.Parent:WaitForChild("Frame")
local event = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("OpenShopGUI")
local text  = frame:WaitForChild("TextLabel")

event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
	frame.Visible = true
	text.Visible = true
	wait(5)
	frame.Visible = false
	text.Visible = false
end)

script_documents.name: Script
script_documents.source:
local prompt = script.Parent
local event = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("OpenShopGUI")

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	-- Sende Nachricht an diesen Spieler, damit das GUI erscheint
	event:FireClient(player)
end)
